facts.text: NEAR Laser Rangefinder (NLR) was deployed at 433 Eros — Himeros Region during NEAR Shoemaker in 2001.
Diode-pumped Nd:YAG pulsed laser transmitter firing 1,064 nm beams at 8 Hz with a 3.5-inch gold-coated receiver telescope.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Mapped over 11 million laser ranging points to create the first complete 3D global topography model of an asteroid.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at 433 Eros — Himeros Region.
Set the precedent for all future asteroid shape modeling, including OSIRIS-REx and Hayabusa2.
